methodology: Each distinct official Japanese printed expansion mark was matched with the original publisher's product release announcement, including set-specific product names. This verifies commercial first release of 28 of 29 named product families before the historical event.
interpretation: Evidence of pre-event Japanese product publication for 28 set families (32 printed card identities). The six physically selected 2025 Championship promo Basic Energy copies lack directly corroborated release day; no claim of full Japanese paper legality.
evidence_class: publisher historical product release dates with exact URL, direct print record for two undated promos
